nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 19 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine three independent current-day early observations updated at 07:37, 08:00 and 08:01 WAT on 20 Nov, rechecked at 08:06 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source and location dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. These are early observations, not live opening or executable quotes. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.

Ghana.note: Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates, 19 Nov (latest dated table).

Kenya.note: CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates, 19 Nov (latest dated table); not a standalone buy or sell quote.

South Africa.note: SARB weighted-average bank rates, 19 Nov; directly verified from the SARB HomePageRates endpoint.

Egypt.note: CBE official buy/sell mid-rates, 19 Nov; midpoints recomputed from buy/sell.
